sourceReferences.title: “是......的”焦点结构及其相关问题探讨 [The discussion of the shì...de focus construction and related issues]

claims.summary: Liu (2018, pp. 11–12, §6, example 31) analyzes 我是来学习汉语的 as a purpose sentence in which the 是…的 pattern has mixed properties; with 来, it can describe arrival before the following activity begins or while it continues, so contextual interpretation matters.

locator.explanation: The paper labels §6 目的句 and explains that 来-cases may describe arrival while the following activity has not begun or is unfinished; the purpose construction mixes SD1 and SD2 properties and requires context.

sourceLinks.notes: This claim is restricted to the source’s analysis of the cited purpose sentences; it does not generalize the pattern to every verb or use.

claims.summary: Liu (2018, §6, example 31) contrasts 我是来学习汉语的 with 我来学习汉语 and 我不是来学习汉语的, and marks *我是来学习的汉语 as unacceptable in the discussed pattern; the article limits its explanation to this cited example.

locator.explanation: The author lists these forms in example (31), marks the final order with an asterisk, and describes the construction’s mixed behavior.

sourceLinks.notes: Other examples from the draft were removed because this source does not cite them.

semanticReview.method: Cotejo directo del artículo académico, sección 6 y ejemplo (31), con contraste de sus ejemplos, condiciones contextuales y asterisco de aceptabilidad; revisión APA 7.
findings: La fuente identifica ejemplos de finalidad con 是…的, analiza la diferencia entre 来 y 去 y especifica que con 来 la interpretación temporal/aspectual depende del contexto.
El ejemplo 31 respalda la forma retenida y sus contrastes; se retiraron los ejemplos del borrador que el artículo no documenta.
limitations: La fuente describe propiedades mixtas entre SD1 y SD2 para las oraciones de finalidad; la ficha no generaliza esta explicación a todo 是…的 ni a todos los verbos de movimiento.
